claims.assertion: From a wider perspective, Yazhi says the repeated Swaruus are one person across life stages, produced through parthenogenesis and recurring time travel aboard two Suzy-class ships.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi presents Swaruus 2–9 as both a reincarnation loop from Swaruu 2 and nine timeline variants; Swaruu 9 branches into other lives or becomes Athena/Swaruu 10.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi models bodies as receivers translating a person’s consciousness from an etheric field; multiple bodies can share it, while mental firewalls preserve some individuality.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
